subject.size_in_frame: whole figure walking toward camera, about 0.30 of frame height, growing to 0.50 as she reaches the table

second_subject.note: catching the lamplight ahead of her, low in frame at 0.715 m — the brightest small thing in the picture before she arrives at it.

headroom: about 0.28 of frame height of hall above her at the far end, closing to 0.16 as she arrives; the lamp row runs away overhead as the top layer and is never cropped out.
horizon_eyeline: Lens at 1.3 m down the hall from the corner entrance: floor and dado converge at [0.52, 0.47]. Her eyeline is at that height too, but wandering — she is looking about her at the walls, not down the axis.

layers.fg: the near flagstones and the nearest lamp pool laid across the bottom of frame
layers.mg: Alice walking back down the middle of the hall
layers.bg: the receding lamp row, the two door lines, and the far end in darkness and haze

gaze.note: she walks the lens axis looking for a way out, so her look sweeps the side walls rather than settling; the frame gives her no single lead room because she has no direction yet. Then the table stops her look at the bottom of frame.

balance: One-point perspective with a small centred figure; the only asymmetry is the glint of the table slightly right of the axis, which is what the eye eventually goes to.
leading_lines: The lamp chain overhead and the floor joints below converge on the same point and pass through the table on the way — the architecture announces the table before she reaches it.
eye_first: The lamp chain, then down it to the small hard glint of the glass table, and only then to her.
constraint_binding: The table announces itself before she reaches it: it is placed inside the perspective funnel and given the frame's highest specular value while she is still deep in the shot, so no push-in or reframe is needed to discover it. Deep staging with the lamp row held as the top layer for the whole shot.
